sources.publisher: Swedish Government; published by Sveriges riksdag
sources.title: Traffic Regulation (1998:1276)
sources.version: Consolidated live text; chapter 3 §§43–45 checked as applicable 13 October 2026
sources.locator: Chapter 3 §45: maximum permitted road speed ≤50, approaching-driver duty and bus caution; §43: safe edge/lateral movement and facilitating observed lane entry
sources.excerpt: utan fara eller onödigt hinder; anpassa hastigheten så att inkörningen underlättas; 50 kilometer i timmen eller lägre
sources.supports: Special bus-stop departure duty at road limits ≤50; no such special duty at 70, but safe-entry and speed-adaptation/cooperation duties remain.
sources.fallback_reason: Inspected TS/TRV results did not establish the complete current 50/70 comparison and reciprocal duties. The current statutory provisions give exact primary legal support.
sources.scope_limits: Ordinary departure from roadside bus stop into the approaching driver’s lane, subject to other applicable controls/rules. Road maximum limit, not actual vehicle speed, determines §45. No unconditional priority or permission to force a gap. “Must give way” in the keyed answer is explained as waiting for a safe entry under §43, not an invented separate always-yield statute.
sources.retrieval_method: Direct primary official page retrieved and exact passage inspected

sources.title: Fakta om ledarhundar
sources.locator: När du möter ett ledarhundsekipage, first and third bullets; Så här arbetar ledarhundar
sources.excerpt: Stör inte ledarhundar som arbetar genom att klappa eller prata med dem.
sources.supports: Avoid petting/talking to distract working guide dogs; distraction can endanger handler; communicate with handler, who chooses route and remains in control.
sources.fallback_reason: No exact guide-dog distraction advice located in TS/TRV searches. MFD is the Swedish government authority responsible for guide-dog services and supplies directly applicable guidance.
sources.scope_limits: Safety/interaction advice, not a newly asserted traffic offence. No claim that the dog alone decides a road is safe or every glance necessarily distracts it.
sources.retrieval_method: Direct primary official page retrieved and exact passage inspected

sources.title: Cykel
sources.locator: Definitionen av en cykel, definition item 1 under Act (2001:559)
sources.excerpt: Ett fordon som är avsett att drivas med tramp- eller vevanordning och inte är ett lekfordon.
sources.supports: An ordinary pedal bicycle is a vehicle even though not motor-driven; a rider is operating a vehicle.
sources.scope_limits: Ordinary pedal bicycle, excluding toy vehicles. No unnecessary e-bike/e-scooter taxonomy or implication that every crossing rule is identical for all vehicles.
sources.retrieval_method: Direct primary official page retrieved and exact passage inspected
